nodes.title: Hazards
nodes.summary: The Hazards section introduces the types of electrical hazards that workers may encounter. It explains why recognizing these hazards is essential for safe work practices.
objectives: Describe the potential consequences of electrical hazards

nodes.title: Shock
nodes.summary: The Shock section explains the phenomenon of electrical shock, focusing on how current flow and the path through the body cause injury. It also highlights the importance of magnitude and exposure duration.
objectives: Describe the factors that influence shock severity

nodes.title: Arc Flash

objectives: Identify conditions that can lead to an arc flash

nodes.title: Controls

objectives: Identify appropriate control measures for electrical hazards

properties.text:
Hazards

The Hazards section introduces the types of electrical hazards that workers may encounter. It explains why recognizing these hazards is essential for safe work practices.

Objectives:
- Identify common electrical hazards
- Describe the potential consequences of electrical hazards
properties.heading: Hazards

properties.text:
Shock

The Shock section explains the phenomenon of electrical shock, focusing on how current flow and the path through the body cause injury. It also highlights the importance of magnitude and exposure duration.

Objectives:
- Explain how electrical shock occurs
- Describe the factors that influence shock severity
properties.heading: Shock

properties.text:
Arc Flash

The Arc Flash section describes the arc flash event, its causes, and the energy released during an incident. It sets the foundation for understanding why protective measures are needed.

Objectives:
- Define arc flash
- Identify conditions that can lead to an arc flash
properties.heading: Arc Flash

properties.text:
Controls

The Controls section covers the strategies used to mitigate electrical hazards, including engineering controls, administrative controls, and personal protective equipment (PPE). It links these controls to the hazards discussed earlier.

Objectives:
- Identify appropriate control measures for electrical hazards
- Explain the role of PPE in protecting against electrical injuries
properties.heading: Controls

properties.text:
PPE

This section introduces Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and focuses on arc‑rated clothing. It explains how arc ratings are expressed in cal/cm² and how layering of garments can increase protection against electrical arcs.

Objectives:
- Identify personal protective equipment requirements for arc hazards
- Explain the meaning of arc rating expressed in cal/cm²
- Describe how layering enhances protection
properties.heading: PPE
